title: A refreshed new website for Monsta Melodic
excerpt: Explore the new look, meet the team and follow our updates in one place.
body: Welcome to the new website! We worked really hard to edit and change it, so I hope you like it.
Volunteer applications are still open! Take a look at the volunteer page if you would like to get involved.

title: IDOL APPLICATIONS ARE CLOSED!
excerpt: Thanks for all the support so far!
body: Idol applications are now closed! Thank you to all the people that applied.
Stay tuned to see all the new updates to come...
